Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical initial error in misattributing the "over 60 million casualties" figure to World War I instead of World War II. This misunderstanding of a key historical fact (World War II had over 60 million casualties, while World War I casualties were significantly lower, around 15-20 million) set the framework for the entire task. As a result, subsequent decisions and steps, including the engagement of WebSurfer, were influenced by the incorrect presumption that World War I was the war matching the casualty figure. This error fits the pattern shown in **Example 1 (Case #396)**, where a misunderstanding of numerical historical information led to an inaccurate conclusion.
